summary: Fixed the CMake build: version read from the subproject VERSION, enable_testing at top level, conditional CKD_STATIC_DEFINE, SOVERSION from major, install rules using GNUInstallDirs with generated headers, relocatable CkdConfig/pkg-config/ckd (RUNPATH and data dir relative to $ORIGIN), SameMajorVersion package. Verified shared, static, lib64 and changed-version builds, ctest 6/6, moved installs, find_package, and add_subdirectory.
